title: National and state evidence snapshots
description: Dated, source-attributed transcriptions from official publishers and published fiscal analysis. These are not live feeds; every value retains its reference period, geography, source and limitations.

observations.title: Life expectancy at birth · male
observations.sourcePublisher: WHO Regional Office for Africa
observations.interpretation: National life-expectancy estimate, not an individual forecast.
limitations: National aggregate only.
Estimate depends on mortality tables and source methodology; it is not a direct count of individual lifespans.

observations.title: Life expectancy at birth · female
observations.sourcePublisher: WHO Regional Office for Africa
observations.interpretation: National life-expectancy estimate, not an individual forecast.
limitations: National aggregate only.
Estimate depends on mortality tables and source methodology; it is not a direct count of individual lifespans.

observations.title: Health expenditure
observations.sourcePublisher: WHO Regional Office for Africa
observations.interpretation: National health-spending context; not a Kaduna health budget or facility allocation.
limitations: National percentage only; it does not identify federal, state or LGA spending distribution.
Health expenditure share is not a measure of service quality or access.

observations.title: Health expenditure per capita
observations.sourcePublisher: WHO Regional Office for Africa
observations.interpretation: National per-capita spending estimate; not household out-of-pocket spending.
limitations: National average masks geographic and income differences.
Do not interpret as a direct allocation to each person or as a measure of effective coverage.

observations.title: National Identification Number enrolment
observations.sourcePublisher: National Identity Management Commission (NIMC)
observations.interpretation: NIMC reported 121,404,601 enrolment records as at 30 June 2025; this is not a population census.
limitations: Reference date is 30 June 2025, not a current 2026 count.
NIN enrolment records are not interchangeable with census population, eligible population or voter-register totals.
State-level enrolment differences do not by themselves establish exclusion or coverage rates without an appropriate population denominator.

observations.title: Real GDP growth
observations.sourcePublisher: International Monetary Fund (IMF) · Nigeria 2026 Article IV Consultation
observations.interpretation: The IMF report table labels 2024 as actual; this is macroeconomic context, not evidence of household welfare or sector outcomes.
limitations: National macroeconomic aggregate only.
Do not mix IMF estimates with NBS official national accounts without retaining the source and vintage.
The IMF report contains estimates and projections for other years; this card displays only the 2024 actual row.

observations.title: Healthy life expectancy at birth
observations.sourcePublisher: WHO Regional Office for Africa
observations.interpretation: WHO's national healthy-life-expectancy estimate; it accounts for time lived in less than full health and is not an individual forecast.
limitations: National aggregate only; not a Kaduna State, LGA or facility measure.
This measure differs from life expectancy at birth; do not compare the two as if they were the same indicator.
Retain the 2023 reference year and WHO methodology.

reconciliationNotes.title: WHO under-five mortality values are not reconciled
reconciliationNotes.detail: WHO AFRO's Nigeria page lists 59.5 deaths per 1,000 live births for 2024; WHO data.who.int lists 117.46 for 2022; a WHO 2025 statistical abstract reports 98.7 for 2024. The series and methods are not reconciled. The 59.5 figure is excluded from the published snapshot; the existing static snapshot retains the WHO country-profile 2022 value with its source period.
reconciliationNotes.action: Do not create a trend line or use the 2024 AFRO figure until the underlying WHO series, model vintage and metadata are reconciled.

reconciliationNotes.title: The 2024/2025 school census portal changed between snapshots
reconciliationNotes.detail: The 18 July 2026 capture and 22 September 2026 capture report different school totals, reporting rates and learner counts for the same school year. The Observatory's existing school census card uses the later 22 September capture; the earlier values are not presented as current.
reconciliationNotes.action: Keep the retrieval date beside the portal snapshot and request a formal revision note or downloadable source extract before calculating trends.

reconciliationNotes.title: State budget performance is not yet a complete 36-state dataset
reconciliationNotes.detail: The 2025 Agora Policy review covers 35 of 36 states and excludes Rivers. BudgIT's H1 2026 review covers 34 of 36 states and excludes Rivers and Osun. The NGF database describes 36-state coverage, but its landing-page integrity is under review and no numeric data have been ingested from it.
reconciliationNotes.action: Show each denominator beside every aggregate; do not label these results 'all states'.

reconciliationNotes.title: FCT budget coverage remains separate and incomplete
reconciliationNotes.detail: FCT is not one of the 36 states. A secondary report of the 2026 budget's passage was found, but the final enacted FCT appropriation law and official implementation reports were not confirmed in this review.
reconciliationNotes.action: Do not include FCT in 36-state totals; acquire the FCTA appropriation law, MTEF, quarterly BIRs and audited accounts separately.

reconciliationNotes.title: NGF public-finance portal requires integrity review
reconciliationNotes.detail: The portal advertises original, revised and actual fiscal data for 36 states, but its rendered landing page included unrelated injected third-party links. No values from it have been ingested.
reconciliationNotes.action: Verify site integrity, direct state-document provenance and downloadable data before relying on this portal.

reconciliationNotes.title: H1 2026 sector spending is not service delivery
reconciliationNotes.detail: BudgIT reports 34-state H1 expenditure, education and health outturns. These figures show budget execution and sector shares, not whether money reached facilities, schools or communities or improved outcomes. Coverage differs by report; the total-expenditure and education pages do not name the excluded states, while the health and revenue pages identify Rivers and Osun.
reconciliationNotes.action: Use these data to select state and sector questions, then reconcile original BIRs, releases, procurement and facility/school-level delivery evidence.

reconciliationNotes.title: Federal Q2 2026 BIR is listed but not publicly downloadable in this review
reconciliationNotes.detail: The Budget Office page lists the Second Quarter 2026 Budget Implementation Report as published 7 November 2026. Both Download and View actions redirected to a login page. No federal execution values have been extracted from this report.
reconciliationNotes.action: Obtain an accessible official copy or open data extract before publishing federal Q2 2026 execution figures.

reconciliationNotes.title: The 2025 federal budget implementation period runs to 31 December 2026
reconciliationNotes.detail: The State House announced on 30 September 2026 that the federal 2025 budget implementation period was extended to 31 December 2026. A 2025 outturn reported before that date is not necessarily the final federal outturn.
reconciliationNotes.action: Label the reporting cut-off and extension status on every federal 2025 comparison; do not treat an interim outturn as final.

reconciliationNotes.title: BudgIT H1 2026 health expenditure totals differ across publications
reconciliationNotes.detail: The 21 October 2026 infographic reports ₦614.55bn for 34 states; the later H1 2026 Subnational Health Expenditure Report reports ₦621.34bn for 34 states. The published summaries do not explain the ₦6.79bn difference. The later detailed report is shown as the latest source, but the discrepancy remains visible and the totals must not be combined or used as a trend until underlying state-level BIRs are reconciled.
reconciliationNotes.action: Obtain the report's state-level annex and underlying 34 BIR extracts, compare state coverage and accounting cut-off, and record a human-reviewed reconciliation before treating the total as final.

reconciliationNotes.title: Anambra Q3 2026 execution must be compared with the elapsed-year period
reconciliationNotes.detail: Anambra's official Q3 2026 BIR covers 1 January–30 September 2026 and reports 30.0% total expenditure performance and 27.8% capital execution. The report explicitly uses 75.0% as the elapsed-year yardstick after nine months. These ratios are fiscal execution indicators, not evidence of service failure or successful delivery.

limitations: These are dated source transcriptions and published research summaries, not live upstream feeds.
Official publication does not equal independent verification; preserve the publisher's method and stated coverage.
A budget allocation is not a release; a release is not expenditure; expenditure is not proof of completed or functional service delivery.
The 2025 and H1 2026 state fiscal comparisons have incomplete state coverage; their denominators are displayed with every observation.
National and multi-state values do not establish conditions in a specific LGA, ward, facility or community.
BudgIT's H1 2026 total expenditure and education infographics each cover 34 states but do not name the two excluded states on their page; do not assume they match the revenue or health samples.
